changelog:
v3.3.2 — Software Decoder Fallback + Diagnostic Fixes

• Software video decoder fallback: auto-switches to software AVC decoder when hardware decoder fails to render frames
• Frame watchdog retry limit: stops infinite reset loop after 4 attempts, shows error dialog
• Track picker language fix: sets preferred audio language so selection persists across rebuffers
• Health monitor bandwidth fix: shows real network throughput instead of 0kbps
• Diagnostic logging: all audio tracks with language + selection state, health monitor lifecycle events
• Series name deduplication: fixes doubled series name in logs and UI when API title includes it
